the_first_question_answered_what_the_two.source: https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/resolve/main/modeling_kimi_linear.py (the TEXT model's file), read verbatim 2026-09-06; line numbers below are that file's.

kda_full_rank_output_gate.declaration: `config.linear_attn_config.get('use_full_rank_gate', False)` (L531). K3 declares `true`. Reference default when absent: False = the low-rank pair.
kda_full_rank_output_gate.init: L533-537: full-rank -> `g_proj = Linear(hidden, projection_size)`; else `g_a_proj = Linear(hidden, head_dim)`, `g_b_proj = Linear(head_dim, projection_size)`; projection_size = num_heads * head_dim.
kda_full_rank_output_gate.forward: L651-654: `g = g_proj(hidden_states)` or `g = g_b_proj(g_a_proj(hidden_states))`; then `g = rearrange(g, '... (h d) -> ... h d')`; `o = o_norm(o, g)` where `o_norm = FusedRMSNormGated(head_dim, eps, activation='sigmoid')` (L539); `o = o_proj(o)`.
kda_full_rank_output_gate.what_changes: ONLY the projection that produces the gate pre-activation. The sigmoid, the gated RMSNorm, and `o_proj` are identical in both forms. `hidden_states` is the attention block's input (post input_layernorm).
kda_full_rank_output_gate.what_it_is_not: not a new gate and not a second gate: KDA has always had this output gate; K3 changes its FORM from rank-128 to full rank. `KdaOp`'s own doc lists 'output gate low rank' among the structural discriminators between KDA and Gated DeltaNet — under full rank that ONE row of the table no longer discriminates; the other five (three projections, three convs, low-rank f gate, per-channel dt_bias, one head count) still do, and identity is DECLARED by `linear_attn_config`/`kda_layers` in any case.

mla_output_gate.declaration: `getattr(config, 'mla_use_output_gate', False)` (L398). K3 declares `true`. Reference default when absent: False = no gate.
mla_output_gate.forward: L470-472: after aggregation and reshape to `[B, T, Hq*v_head_dim]`: `g = g_proj(hidden_states).sigmoid(); attn_output = attn_output * g`; then `o_proj`.
mla_output_gate.what_it_is: exactly the softmax family's `attn_output_gate` this build already represents: `AttentionGateSpec { source: AttentionInput, activation: Sigmoid, combine: ElementwiseMultiply, placement: AfterAggregationBeforeOutputProjection }`, at width `Hq * v_head_dim` instead of `Hq * head_dim`. `hidden_states` is the MLA block's input (post input_layernorm).
mla_output_gate.what_it_is_not: not a gate on the KV latent, not a gate on the query; nothing about the compressed cache changes.

decisions_the_freeze_must_settle_not_dec: 1 REPRESENTATION OF THE KDA FORM: an enum on `KdaOp` (`KdaOutputGate::LowRank { g_a, g_b } | FullRank { g_proj }`) versus two optional fields. `KdaOp`'s own doc ('a second gate form ... belongs in its own field rather than changing what this one means') argues for a typed form; `KdaWeights`, `KdaDeviceWeights`, `KdaOperands`, `kda_f32s`, `plan_roles` all follow the type.

2 REPRESENTATION OF THE MLA GATE: reuse `AttentionGateSpec` on `MlaSurface`/`MlaOp.output_gate: Option<OperandRef>` (the softmax precedent, field for field) versus an MLA-specific type. The spec's four enums already say exactly what L470-472 does.

3 DECLARATION SEMANTICS: absent key = the reference's own default (low-rank / no gate) — a CHECKED default read from L531 and L398, not an assumed one — carried as `Option<bool>` so 'undeclared' stays distinguishable, with the operand plane REQUIRED to agree and every disagreement refused by name (identity declared, not inferred).

4 ROLES: `KdaGProj` in `KDA_ROLE_TABLE` and `MlaOutputGate` in `MLA_ROLE_TABLE`, same spelling, operator-gated (the o_proj precedent), expected shapes `[Hv*Dv, hidden]` and `[Hq*v_head_dim, hidden]` from each geometry; whether the table entry is ALSO gated on the declaration (as `ATTENTION_RESIDUAL_ROLE_TABLE` is) or the declaration is checked at closure.

5 SEMANTIC CLUSTER: introduce an attention-output-gate cluster taking `attn_output_gate`, `output_gate_type`, `use_full_rank_gate`, `mla_use_output_gate`, or leave all four Unclustered as the precedent is. Clustering changes finding text, not counts.

6 CARRIAGE: `Lowered` for both once the CPU executor consumes them; what the Metal plane does in the same PR (carry the form / refuse by name) and whether a Metal refusal is an `unsupported_component` finding.

7 THE VERDICT TRAP: if declare/own/address lands WITHOUT execution, the honest state is 'represented, executor refuses by name' = a NEW unsupported_component finding on `target.execution_surface` -> K3 flips RED -> AMBER again (a verdict moves on CLASS, not count; ATTNRES-1 transition 1 did exactly this, then the lift undid it). The freeze must choose: one transition that declares AND executes (no flip), or two with the flip forecast and scored.

8 SCOPE FENCES: the MLA q-LoRA cell (`q_a_proj`/`q_a_layernorm`/`q_b_proj`, `q_lora_rank`) is NOT this rung's — named as the reason K3's MLA layer still does not close after it; `situ`, latent MoE, MXFP4, `topk_method`, vision, `A_log [128]` untouched.

9 ORACLES: extend `kda_reference.py`/`kimi_mla_reference.py` with the gate form as a parameter and export SECOND fixture arms (full-rank / gated) beside the existing ones; controls measured and recorded with deltas; the gate band asserted; the existing low-rank/no-gate parity tests unchanged.

10 SEMANTICS VERSION 18 -> 19 and the identity pin's verdict pair (a synthetic KDA estate declaring full rank with `g_proj` is admissible; the same estate declaring full rank with `g_a`/`g_b` is refused by name; a synthetic MLA estate declaring the gate with `g_proj` is admissible; shipping `g_proj` undeclared is refused).
